content.short: Keeta Network is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain designed as an institutional financial settlement layer.
content.description:
Keeta Network is a next-generation Layer 1 blockchain engineered to serve as a secure and highly scalable financial settlement layer for the global economy. Utilizing a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) structure and a unique "atomic architecture," the network achieves a claimed throughput of over 10 million transactions per second with sub-second finality. Keeta positions itself as a robust alternative to traditional banking rails like SWIFT, featuring built-in KYC/AML compliance and native engines for the tokenization of real-world assets (RWAs).

Backed by industry leaders and designed for institutional-grade performance, Keeta Network aims to bridge the gap between traditional finance and decentralized technology. The network is powered by the $KTA token, which facilitates transaction fees, staking, and decentralized governance. By providing a compliant and efficient framework for digital asset management, Keeta is empowering financial institutions and developers to build the next generation of global financial services on-chain.
